title: Beasties: Offline Puzzle Games
summary: Sort puzzles and brain teasers with monsters, offline and without a single ad. 19 games, over 75,000 levels: Gnatz and the gang are waiting for you. STACKS: THE SORT PUZZLE Move the monsters from pole to pole until every pole holds just one family. Sleepy monsters only wake up when they reach the top. Every level can be solved, and the fewer moves you need, the more stars you win. MORE GAMES TO PLAY • Triple Trouble: swap monsters and line up three of a kind. • Tile Pile: pick tiles off the pile and match three on your bench. • Bumper Cars: tap the cars out of the arena without a single crash. • Laundry Day: hang three matching socks on one line. • Block Munch: place the pieces, fill lines and clear the fog. • Hive Stacks: drop monster stacks on the honeycomb, and ten of a kind get gobbled up. • Paint Trail: swipe, and the monster paints every tile it slides over. • Ice Slide: tilt the pond and slide every monster into its own nest. • Colour Gulp: pick a shade, and the slime gulps every matching tile it touches. BRAIN TEASERS • Sudoku: 1 to 9 once in every row, column and box. Always one solution. • Nonogram: paint cells by the number clues and a pixel monster appears. • Mines: use the numbers to find every monster asleep under the tiles, without waking one. • Dens: one monster per den, never two in a row or column, never touching. • Number Bite: keep the digits that make the sums, and Gnatz munches the rest. • Cage Sums: sudoku with dashed cages, the digits in each cage add up to its sum. • Number Pairs: clear pairs that are equal or make 10 until the field is empty. • Number Cross: a crossword with digits, every line adds up to its clue. • Goo Pipes: turn the pipes until the goo reaches every hungry monster, without a leak. AT YOUR OWN PACE • No ads, ever, not even for a hint • Plays offline: on the train, on a plane, at the bottom of the garden • No account, no sign-up • No timer, no lives, no waiting • Four difficulties: Chill, Normal, Tricky and Devilish • Three daily challenges, every day YOUR MONSTER, YOUR STYLE Win stars, hatch eggs and dress up your monster in the monster workshop: hats, eyes, horns, patterns and more. The free season pass adds parts you can only get that season. BEASTIES PRO Every game has 150 free levels on each of Chill, Normal and Tricky, and you can unlock more with stars. A one-time purchase unlocks all 999 levels per difficulty in every game, the Devilish difficulty and 500 bonus stars. No subscription, and it works with Family Sharing. An idea or a problem? Tap "Write feedback" in the app. We read every message.

title: RTÉ Listen
summary: From breaking news to great music and brilliant storytelling, RTÉ Listen lets you play live radio or hear the latest podcasts and on-demand audio from RTÉ. LIVE RADIO PLAYER: Tune in to RTÉ Radio 1, RTÉ 2FM, RTÉ lyric fm, RTÉ Raidió na Gaeltachta and RTÉ Gold. ON-DEMAND RADIO: Pick up where you left off or play full episodes of your favourite shows, like Brendan O'Connor, Marty in the Morning, Morning Ireland and 2FM Drive with Laura and Katja. TRENDING CLIPS: Catch the moments everyone's talking about, from the biggest trending interviews to the best bits from across the RTÉ schedule. DOWNLOADS AND FAVOURITES: Create an account to favourite shows you love, manage your queue and download episodes for on-the-go.

title: Pigeon Puzzle
summary: Each swipe sends your pigeon sliding until something stops it. Cats take one step after every move, so think ahead. Every level can be solved, and there's a shortest route to find if you want all three stars. New levels arrive with every update. - Over 1,100 puzzles: 739 levels across twelve places (Rooftops and The Funfair are free, plus Train Station, Park, Night City, Harbour, The Loft, The Clock Tower, The Golf Course, The Snooker Hall, The Prison Yard and The Building Site) and a Daily Coo for every day of the year - Pieces that move: a window cleaner's cradle, a train across the line, a drawbridge, a night bus, a mother duck and her ducklings, a seesaw over the pond, a Ferris wheel, a tower crane and more - Sleepy cats, cracked tiles, crates to push, wet cement and a rising tide to outsmart - Feathers that flap you over chimneys, pigeon lofts that pop you across the roof, and a friend pigeon who copies every glide - A new Daily Coo puzzle every day, with rewards just for playing - Your flock grows as you play: a new pigeon joins every five levels - Make your own levels and share them with friends - Dress up your pigeon with looks and hats, and pick a theme you like, pink included - Unlimited undo and a free hint whenever you're stuck - Plays in English and 22 other languages - Game Center leaderboards and achievements - Plays fully offline - New levels and new places in every update, free in the packs you own - No ads. Buy a pack once and keep it forever.

title: Unraveled - Ravelry Companion
summary: Unraveled is an independent third-party client for Ravelry. It's the fastest way to manage your projects, browse patterns, organize your stash, get inspiration, and keep up with your queue. Beautifully designed for iPhone and iPad. Built to get out of your way so you can spend more time doing what you love most. WHAT YOU GET • Projects — view, edit, add photos, and note every project. Track status, progress, gauge, needles, hooks, and yarn. • Queue — what's next, prioritized your way. Quick-add from any pattern. • Stash & Library — your yarn, patterns, and purchase history, fully searchable. • Favorites & Bundles — collect patterns by project, season, or theme. • Search — the full filter set: craft, weight, fiber type, sort, and dozens more, in a native iOS interface. • Messages & Friends — your messages and friend activity, on the go. • Widgets — projects, queue, stash, and Hot Right Now widgets in every size, right in your home screen. Tap to jump straight into the right place. • iPad Sidebar — adaptive split view for browsing patterns and projects side by side. • Quick Actions — press and hold any project, pattern, or stash item for a shortcut menu of common things you'd do next. • Ravelry your way — reorder filters and tabs so you can get to what you care about quicker than ever. • Built for iOS 26 — Dynamic Type, Dark Mode, VoiceOver, Reduced Motion, and Spotlight deep links throughout. NO SUBSCRIPTION. NO ADS. NO TRACKING. Unraveled is free for 14 days with full access to every feature. After the trial, a one-time $7.99 unlock gives you lifetime access. No recurring fees. No advertising. No third-party tracking. Just a beautifully made tool that gets out of your way so you can get back to crafting. “I just downloaded your app and it's stunning. It's the first app I've seen that really looks like Ravelry!” — Michelle “That was quick... 3 minutes to download and update my latest projects with photos. I'd never do that in a browser while waiting for food on Market Street!” — Emily, San Francisco “Finally! A well designed Ravelry app for Apple devices!!” — Brittany Download now and find out what all the hype is about!

title: Spellweaver's Deck: Roguelike
summary: A dark-fantasy roguelike deckbuilder where the story changes the cards in your hand. Built for one-thumb portrait play on iPhone. Pay once. No ads, no energy, no pay-to-win. The Hush is spreading through Vessany, taking voices, then names, then the people who owned them. You are a Spellweaver. You bind spells, oaths and memories into a grimoire of cards, and you set out from the Loom to learn what the silence wants. Every run is a new weave. Every choice leaves a thread behind. FOUR SPELLWEAVERS, FOUR WAYS TO FIGHT • Ashbinder – stoke Ember and let Burn do the killing. • Warden – raise Barriers, swear Oaths, and make every blow cost them. • Veilsinger – sow Dread, Echo your best spells, Exhaust what you no longer need. • Bonecaller – spend Bone Shards and your own blood, then hex the weakened. Almost 400 cards to collect and play, dozens of relics, dual-path upgrades, and Inscriptions that rewrite every card they touch. Read enemy intents, plan the turn, drag a card onto or tap and select its target. COMPANIONS WHO REMEMBER Recruit allies who bring their own gift cards and a once-per-fight intervention you trigger from the battle screen. Earn their devotion and they fight harder. Lose their trust and they leave, and the card they gave you curdles into a Regret curse in your deck. Every companion has a fate waiting on the ending screen. A WORLD THAT TALKS BACK More than a hundred story events across three acts. Bosses and elites speak when you meet them, when they turn, and when they die. Choices you made in Act I send their invoices in Act III. Multiple endings, and secrets past them. THE LOOM REMEMBERS Fall, and bind one earned card to the Loom for the next Weaver to carry. Spend Threads on new classes, cards, relics and boons. Climb ten levels of Weave Depth. Stack Trials for a higher score multiplier. Watch the tapestry gain a band with every victory, and the sky over the Loom remember how you ended. MORE WAYS TO WEAVE • Daily Weave – one seed for everyone, with rival ghosts showing where they fell. • Weekly Gauntlet – a named modifier stack, three attempts, a recurring leaderboard. • The Tolling – six bells, elite to boss, about twelve minutes. • Loomcast – draft your grimoire before you set out. • Seeded practice – any seed, any unlocked depth. MADE FOR IPHONE, WORKS ON IPAD Portrait, one-thumb, drag-to-target. Haptics, floating numbers, screen shake, and a full score with act, boss, shop and rest themes. Autosave and resume at any moment. Game Center leaderboards and achievements. iCloud backup of your progress. Plays offline. FAIR BY DESIGN Buy it once and the whole game is yours. The optional extras are cosmetic: card backs, card faces, tapestry themes, thread dyes. Nothing you can buy changes a card, a drop rate, or a difficulty. Money never buys balance. The world is falling silent. What will you weave?

title: Still: Breathing Exercises
summary: Wind down after work with a short breathing practice. Start with six free practices, including Box Breathing and 4-7-8 Breathing, at 3 and 5 minutes. Choose a quiet reset, refocus between tasks, or make a little room as you wind down. Follow one living ring with visual cues and gentle haptics. No account needed. BOX AND 4-7-8 BREATHING, FREE Two well-known named rhythms, free at 3 and 5 minutes. Box Breathing: 4 in · 4 hold · 4 out · 4 pause. 4-7-8 Breathing: 4 in · 7 hold · 8 out. Holds are gentle and optional, the voice stays silent while you hold, and you can breathe out early at any time. Box Breathing also comes as a 10-minute session with Premium; 4-7-8 Breathing is offered at 3 and 5 minutes. START FREE Repeat the six free practices as often as you like. Soft rain and noise backgrounds, personal practice history, and history backups through Files or iCloud Drive stay free. Full English voice guidance is part of Still Premium; free 30-second samples let you hear it before subscribing. FIND YOUR RHYTHM Clear visual cues and gentle haptics guide each practice. Preview the English voice with free 30-second samples. Breathe comfortably and return to your own pace whenever you need to. EXPLORE STILL PREMIUM Make more room for your practice with the complete library of 26 practices, 3-, 5-, and 10-minute sessions, all 10 soundscapes, English voice guidance, and four guided collections. Every subscription plan includes the same Premium access. Anyone can browse the collections, and days built on free practices can be started without Premium. KEEP A QUIET HISTORY See your completed sessions, minutes, weekly rhythm, and streaks. Your practice history is stored locally, with optional synchronization through your private iCloud database. READY OFFLINE Practices and audio are bundled in the app. Buying or restoring Premium needs an internet connection; verified, active Premium access supports offline practice. The app interface is available in English, German, French, Spanish, Japanese, and Portuguese (Brazil); voice guidance is in English. No advertising or cross-app tracking. Apple and RevenueCat process purchases and subscription-related information, as described in our Privacy Policy. Still Premium is an optional auto-renewable subscription. Plans, prices, and billing periods are shown before purchase. Eligible subscribers may receive a free trial on the weekly or yearly plan; the renewal price and billing period are shown before purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings. Still provides general-wellness breathing and mindfulness content, not medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Stop if you feel unwell or uncomfortable. Do not practice while driving, in water, or during an activity requiring your full attention. title: Teddy Dreams: Match 3 Puzzle
summary: Teddy Dreams is a cozy teddy bear puzzle game with soft bedtime charm, juicy match gameplay, and dream-world surprises. Swap teddy bears to make matches, collect level goals, and use powerful bonus items like Blanket Rockets, Pillow Pops, Honey Hearts, and Sparkle Stars. Every level brings a fresh goal: clear special bears, break sleepy obstacles, collect memory cards, rescue falling stars, or survive playful gravity changes. FEATURES • Match colorful teddy bears in quick, satisfying levels • Use cozy bonuses and huge combo clears • Clear Pillow Blocks, Blanket Knots, Toy Boxes, and Dream Fog • Play unlimited journey levels with rising challenge • Try daily challenges and build win streaks • Unlock new teddy styles with useful perks • Follow Teddy across a dreamy level map • Enjoy readable goals, soft animations, and gentle fail states Teddy Dreams is made for short puzzle sessions that still feel magical. Plan smart swaps, set up bonuses, and help Teddy bring light back to each cozy dream.

title: Bloom: Garden Puzzle Game
summary: Merge two matching flowers, grow a garden, and turn a single seed into a mythical bloom. A relaxing offline tile puzzle with no account, no wifi and no timers. Free to play, forever. HOW TO PLAY • Swipe up, down, left, or right to slide every tile in that direction • Two matching plants merge into the next stage and grow your score • The run keeps going forever, until the board fills up and no merges remain WHAT MAKES BLOOM DIFFERENT • Endless growth. The trophy is just the beginning. Mythical tiers stack past it • Calm, hand-drawn pixel art with gentle haptic feedback on every merge • Plays fully offline, bring it to flights, subways, and waiting rooms • Global leaderboard via World Ladder, see how your best stacks up worldwide • No accounts, no sign-ups, no friend invites. Just plants PERFECT FOR • Five minutes between meetings • Wind-down before bed • Anyone who loves merge / 2048-style puzzles Grow life from a seed. One tap at a time.

title: Clicklet
summary: Clicklet lets the Camera Control button on your iPhone start your Apple Shortcuts. Pick one shortcut to launch with a press, or turn on Menu mode and choose from a few favorites each time. Clicklet opens Apple Shortcuts to run your workflow, so you'll see the usual Shortcuts screens, along with any permission prompts or app handoffs your shortcut needs. To set up your library, install the included Connect Clicklet helper. It brings in your shortcut names and small icon images, which appear in your library, in the menu, and while a shortcut opens. You can also search for a shortcut or type its name. If you used an earlier version, replace the old helper with the new one and refresh to get icons. From the menu, tap Configure to go back to setup. You can scroll the menu by dragging along its side margins. Your shortcut names, icons and selections stay on your device. There's no account, advertising, analytics, subscription or in-app purchase. Camera access supports the Camera Control and lock-screen handoff and shows a live preview; Clicklet doesn't save photos or videos. Launching while your iPhone is locked requires authentication. Requires iOS 18 or later and Apple's Shortcuts app. Launching from the button requires an iPhone with Camera Control; set Clicklet in Settings > Camera > Camera Control. Opening Clicklet on its own shows your setup without running a shortcut.

title: Fields Of Fortune
summary: Fields of Fortune is a cozy farming game made to be played fully with VoiceOver, and just as fun to play by sight. Every screen is laid out for swiping, every picture is described in words, and every action tells you exactly what happened. GROW YOUR FARM Plant dozens of crops, watch them grow in real time and harvest them in normal, good and excellent quality. Buy more land as you level up, all the way to level 200. RAISE AND BREED ANIMALS Keep chickens, cows, sheep, horses, alpacas, unicorns and many more. Feed them the foods they love, collect their products, help them level up from Standard to Elite, and breed pairs to discover rare new breeds. Dress your animals in clothes you make in the Tailor Shop. MAKE GOODS Turn your harvest into bread, cheese, jam, wine, pizza, sweaters and over a hundred other goods in your own bakery, dairy, kitchen, winery and more. Hire workers to keep production running. FISH FROM THE PIER Cast your line, hear the distance read with every click as you pull back, wait for a bite and reel in fish, shells and rare sea treasures. Upgrade your poles and bait as you go. FARM WITH FRIENDS Add friends, visit their farms, water their crops, feed their animals, send gifts and trade items. Chat with everyone in public chat or privately with friends. Sell your goods to other players on the marketplace. DAILY GOALS AND CHALLENGES Collect a daily reward, complete daily quests, earn bronze, silver and gold medals, climb the leaderboards and compete in weekly challenges for surprise rewards. MADE FOR VOICEOVER - No headings to hunt for: swipe through each screen from the top. - Long lists are grouped into lists that open and close, each with its numbers. - Sounds, music and haptics for every action, with full volume controls. - Reduce Motion is respected everywhere. OPTIONAL PURCHASES The whole game is free to play. The Store sells Fortune Gem packs, for time in the forest and forest tools, three animals you cannot get anywhere else, and Farm Pass, a monthly subscription with extra gifts, free twin breeding on friends' farms and time with your animals. Farm Pass renews monthly until you cancel.
